entities.summary: Dostyk or Druzhba is a small town in Kazakhstan's Jetisu Region, on the border with Xinjiang, China. It is a port of entry from China. The rail portion serves as an important link in the Eurasian Land Bridge. It is situated in the Dzungarian Gate, a historically significant mountain pass. Dostyk is a human settlement in Central Asia, established around 1956. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
